claims.claim: You need your business name to register as an employer.
claims.note: The employer registration pages do not list the business name as information needed to register.

claims.claim: You need your business address to register as an employer.
claims.note: The employer registration pages do not list the business address as information needed; the registered office address rules in the linked page are about Companies House registration, a different service.

claims.claim: You need to give the nature of your business to register as an employer.
claims.note: The text does not say the nature of the business is needed to register as an employer.

claims.claim: You need the date of your first payday to register as an employer.
claims.quote: You must register before the first payday to get your employer PAYE reference number.
claims.note: The text ties registration timing to the first payday but does not say the date of the first payday is information you must provide.
